title: Membership in the circuit family language
statement: Let $C$ be a family of layered circuits and let $w$ be a finite Boolean word. Then $w$ belongs to the language accepted by $C$ if and only if the circuit in the family for inputs of length $|w|$, evaluated on the input obtained by encoding each bit of $w$ as its corresponding element of $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$, outputs $1$.
